To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

marketing is a management tool that can contribute to the achievement of the strategic goals of a healthcare organization operating in a public system by improving the quality of the services provided, increasing the efficiency of its resources, and strengthening its relations with the environment.

the marketing function can be developed in PHSs by adopting a marketing orientation, which can be achieved through the implementation of a marketing strategy, the development of marketing competencies and the use of marketing tools.

the marketing function can bring a number of benefits to healthcare providers in PHSs, and that these benefits can be achieved by applying a marketing function that is based on the following elements: - the identification of the organization’s mission; - the identification of stakeholders and the definition of the relationships to be built with them, including the identification of the value proposition; - the definition of the marketing mix; - the development of a marketing plan.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a conceptual framework for marketing in PHSs.
the following issues: (1) what is marketing in the healthcare context, (2) what are its scopes and elements, and (3) what are the approaches to marketing by PHSs.
the role of marketing in PHSs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
marketing is a strategic tool that can be applied to the healthcare sector in order to improve its efficiency and effectiveness in the delivery of services.
the scope of marketing is wider in the healthcare sector than it is in other sectors and that marketing in the healthcare sector has to be adapted to its specific characteristics.
a marketing function should be developed within the healthcare organizations operating in PPSs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the incorporation of marketing in the public sector should not be seen as a simple transfer of marketing practices from the commercial sector to the PHSs.
the incorporation of marketing in healthcare services in PHSs is an issue to be taken very seriously.
the marketing function in PHSs is not a new issue, but rather a renewed approach to an old issue.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a marketing function is not an end in itself but a tool that should be used to achieve specific goals, depending on the organization’s strategy and on the characteristics of its operating environment.
the marketing function can be a valuable asset for healthcare organizations operating in PPHs and can be developed in different forms.

marketing in healthcare organizations in PHSs is an emerging field and a variety of approaches can be adopted, depending on the specific characteristics of each organization and the healthcare environment in which it operates.
